stage_meta.name: CHOP-MID
stage_meta.desc: No-trend base: RSI ~45-60, MACD flat — market idhar-udhar
stage_meta.rule: Chop hai, koi edge nahi. Fresh trade NO — jab tak stage break na ho.

stage_meta.name: CHOP-UP
stage_meta.desc: Recovery shuru: chop ke andar RSI 60+ ya RSI 52+ ke saath MACD+
stage_meta.rule: Trigger (cross/div) aa gaya toh T3 candidate — par T3 ka edge nahi hai, sirf T1 confirm hone pe hi trade.

stage_meta.name: STRONG-FLOW
stage_meta.desc: Trend ban raha hai: SMA200 upar + SMA50 up + ADX>=20 + RSI>=55 + MACD+
stage_meta.rule: ENTRY (T1/T2). Next open pe 1x long (CE). Stop = entry - 2xATR. Exit: trend-flip ya week-2..4 window.

stage_meta.name: ALL-ALIGN BULL
stage_meta.desc: Sab green aligned: TREND UP regime + RSI 55-71 + SMA200 ke upar
stage_meta.rule: ENTRY / HOLD (T1/T2). Exit: TOP-WARNING pe partial lock; trend-flip pe full.

stage_meta.name: TOP-WARNING
stage_meta.desc: Thakawat: RSI 72+ ya bearish divergence — bull-run ka last phase
stage_meta.rule: Naya long mat lo. Andar ho toh 50% lock karo, baaki trend-flip pe.

stage_meta.name: CHOP-DOWN
stage_meta.desc: Weak chop: RSI<=45 ya MACD deep- (-15 se neeche) — neeche jhukta hua
stage_meta.rule: No entry. Momentum long ke liye ye zona forbidden hai.

stage_meta.name: WEAK
stage_meta.desc: Structure gir raha: RSI<=38 + SMA50 ke neeche
stage_meta.rule: Agar trade andar ho toh exit karo. Naya long strictly NO.

stage_meta.name: BEAR
stage_meta.desc: TREND DOWN regime (ADX>=25, -DI upar) — market gir raha hai
stage_meta.rule: Long avoid karo. Short-lean sirf paper experiment ke liye.

stage_meta.name: PANIC
stage_meta.desc: Falling knife: TREND DOWN + RSI<=35 + MACD- + SMA50 neeche
stage_meta.rule: Chaku mat pakdo — oversold ke baad bhi aage girta hai. RSI>40 recovery wait.

stage_meta.name: EARLY-UP
stage_meta.desc: TREND UP andar hai par momentum thanda (RSI<55) — pullback ya fresh start
stage_meta.rule: Jo trade andar hai usse hold. Naya entry T2 (re-accel) confirmation pe.
